title: Trevi Therapeutics, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Trevi Therapeutics, Inc., a Delaware biotech company, filed an 8-K announcing an underwritten public offering of 11,600,000 shares of common stock at $13.00 per share, expected to close on or about April 20, 2026. The company estimates net proceeds of approximately $141.1 million (or $162.4 million if underwriters exercise their option in full), after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions. Proceeds are intended to fund development of Haduvio for chronic cough indications, including Phase 3 trials for IPF-related cough and Phase 2b trials for non-IPF ILD and refractory chronic cough.
key_points: Trevi Therapeutics priced an underwritten offering of 11,600,000 shares at $13.00 per share on April 16, 2026
Underwriters Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC and Leerink Partners LLC purchased shares at $12.22 per share (5.95% underwriting discount)
Company granted underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 1,740,000 additional shares at the same price
Estimated net proceeds: approximately $141.1 million (or $162.4 million if option exercised in full)
Closing expected on or about April 20, 2026, subject to customary conditions
Proceeds fund Haduvio development including two planned Phase 3 trials for IPF-related chronic cough
